services.label: Why Investors Choose Jacko
services.subtitle: No other GC in Richmond can say this: we flip houses ourselves. That changes everything about how we renovate yours.

items.name: Investor Who Builds
items.desc: Jakson (Jacko's owner) flips houses himself. He knows purchase prices, ARVs, holding costs, and margins, not because a client told him, but because he lives it on his own deals. When he renovates your flip, he thinks about the deal the way you do.

items.name: One Team, Every Trade
items.desc: One call, one crew, 20 people. We handle kitchen, baths, flooring, HVAC, paint, electrical, and plumbing. No subcontractor headaches. No waiting on 5 different schedules. One timeline, one point of contact.

items.name: Repeat Investor Trust
items.desc: Our investors come back. That tells you more than any review. In a business where most contractor relationships last one project, repeat business is proof that cannot be faked.

items.name: Richmond Market Knowledge
items.desc: We know what Richmond buyers want. Ceramic in bathrooms and kitchens: yes. High-end materials that cost double for barely-above-medium quality: no. Some neighborhoods prefer tubs over standing showers. We invest here, so we know your market.
